children: How AI-Powered CyPath Lung Test Operates
CyPath Lung offers a noninvasive option to enhance early lung cancer detection in high-risk individuals.
The test utilizes advanced flow cytometry paired with proprietary artificial intelligence to identify malignant cell populations in sputum samples.
It incorporates a specialized fluorescent porphyrin that cancer and cancer-related cells preferentially absorb.
Clinical Performance and Diagnostic Potential

In published clinical trials of high-risk patients with indeterminate nodules under 20 millimeters, CyPath Lung demonstrated 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 88% accuracy, and a 99% negative predictive value.
These metrics reflect initial detection settings and await separate validation for post-treatment monitoring.
The high negative predictive value gives physicians greater confidence in negative results, potentially sparing patients from unnecessary and costly invasive procedures.
Marketed as a Laboratory Developed Test, CyPath Lung serves as a complementary diagnostic tool alongside other clinical findings rather than a standalone evaluation.
